config_name: IdeaPad Slim 3i 15.3" — Core 5 320, 8GB DDR5, 256GB SSD, WUXGA IPS 60Hz

specs.ports: 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen1, 1x USB-C 3.2 Gen1 (PD3.0, DP1.2), HDMI 1.4, 3.5mm

battery.notes: ~34Wh (4422 mAh) — the smaller battery of the 3i line; ~4-5h real web use.

price.notes: BF sale $499.99 — the cheapest current-CPU 15" laptop at BBY this cycle.

offers.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3i 15.3" 60Hz Laptop - Intel Core 5 320 - 8GB RAM - 256GB SSD - Windows 11 Home - Luna Grey

reviews.quote: Targets budget-oriented laptops, but the performance results are nothing too exciting; a solid all-round cheap everyday machine.
A dependable machine for $799 with a bright screen and solid performance for everyday use.
Pedestrian performance and budget-grade construction; at $1,299 we simply can't justify it.

praises: $499.99 sale price for a current-gen Core 5 320 with a WUXGA IPS panel is the floor of the market
Same thin 1.59 kg chassis as the pricier 3i SKUs — no bulk penalty for the cheap tier
CPU handles office/web/Zoom multitasking without stutter despite the price
USB-C power delivery means any 65W charger works on the road
Quiet under light loads; fan is barely audible for browsing and docs
complaints: Small ~34Wh battery: roughly an hour less runtime than the 512GB twin with the same CPU
256GB SSD leaves ~180GB free after Windows and updates — fills within months
720p webcam is soft and noisy on video calls (downgrade from the 512GB SKU's 1080p)
45% NTSC panel is dim and washed out; unsuitable for any colour-sensitive work
Plastic chassis flexes in the deck and lid; hinge feels loose after months of opening

standouts: Cheapest entry in the whole budget dataset at its $499.99 sale price — a genuine emergency/student machine
dealbreakers: 256GB SSD + 8GB RAM together make this a dead-end for anyone keeping it 3+ years
design_philosophy: The floor SKU of Lenovo's volume budget chassis: identical thin shell and current Core 5 320 CPU as the better 3i models, with the cost cut taken from battery capacity (34Wh vs 47Wh), storage, and webcam. It exists to hit the sub-$500 sale shelf; everything else about it is ordinary budget-class.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the 512GB Core 5 320 SKU anchoring (see SHARED-ideapad-slim3.md): −1.3 battery for the 34Wh vs 47Wh pack, −2 webcam_speakers for 720p vs 1080p IR, −0.3 productivity for the tighter 256GB drive. No pro score found; nits and hours are class estimates. SD reader not listed in BBY specs for this SKU.
